{{Quote|Possessed by the dark spirit of Naga Sadow, Gynt attacked his former master in broad daylight. The brutal battle between the two was staged with all of the Republic watching.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
Around [[3749 BBY|seventy-five years]] before the [[Great Galactic War]], a '''lightsaber duel''' occurred on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] was fought between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Barel Ovair]] and his former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Eison Gynt]]. After being [[Mission to Yavin 4|abandoned]] by Ovair [[Time/Legends|years]] before on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Gynt had become possessed by the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of the long-[[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. Sadow sought to kill Ovair, who was in fact an agent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]] and was operating within the Republic as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in preparation for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] future invasion of the Republic. The possessed Gynt attacked Ovair on Coruscant but was defeated in the ensuing [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]]. In killing his former apprentice, Ovair also fulfilled a directive handed down to him by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]&mdash;to neutralize the spirits of past Sith in order to avoid complications when the Empire's invasion commenced.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Gynt and Master Ovair fought bravely against the Massassi, but they were defeated and forced to flee deep into the temple. There, they encountered the dark energies still lingering in Naga Sadow's tomb.|Gnost-Dural, on the mission to Yavin 4|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
[[File:NagaSadowTomb-Timeline7.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ovair and Gynt in the heart of Naga Sadow's tomb]]
Following the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the resulting [[Dark Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] enjoyed a period of peace and expansion. The Republic, however, was unaware of a growing threat in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]&mdash;the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]], which was preparing itself for war. As part of his preparations for the war, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] dispatched agents of the Empire to infiltrate the Republic and destabilize the government prior to the arrival of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] military.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

Among these agents was the [[Ovair family]], which had been tasked with infiltrating the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the Ovairs traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], ostensibly to research locations strong in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. In truth, they were working to neutralize the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirits]] of dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] who might attempt to challenge the rule of the Sith [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] upon his return to known [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. In [[3756 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Barel Ovair]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Eison Gynt]], undertook a [[Mission to Yavin 4|mission]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]&mdash;the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that served as the final resting place of the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]]. Although Ovair intended to destroy Sadow's lingering spirit, his plan was side-railed when the Jedi were attacked by Sadow's surviving [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors and were forced to flee deep into [[Naga Sadow's tomb|Sadow's tomb]]. Ovair abandoned Gynt there and fled back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he claimed that his apprentice had been [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Timeline 7" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Gynt's borrowed powers were formidable, but Master Ovair won the day.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
[[File:Gynt_dead.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Eison Gynt is defeated.]]
Several [[Time/Legends|years]] after the events on Yavin 4, Gynt returned to Coruscant. The young Jedi had been possessed by the dark spirit of Sadow and was committed to finding and killing his former Master. Garbed in the [[Sith apparel|apparel]] of a Massassi warrior, the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] attacked Ovair in broad daylight. A crowd formed around the two as they [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]], with Gynt attacking with his single [[Color/Legends|green]] blade and Ovair defending himself with his purple [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Timeline 7" />

Despite the dark [[Force power/Legends|powers]] granted to Gynt by Sadow, Ovair struck down his apprentice by cutting him across his torso. Gynt's death also neutralized Sadow's spirit.<ref name="Timeline 7" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Ovair's triumph over darkness was celebrated, and the Jedi Council assumed that all was well. The question no one asked was this: 'Why would Naga Sadow's spirit seek vengeance, specifically against Master Ovair?'|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 7" />}}
Ovair's victory was lauded by the Jedi, and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] assumed that despite the tragedy that had befallen young Gynt, the situation had passed, and that there was no reason for further concern. Ovair continued in his capacity as a Jedi Master,<ref name="Timeline 7" /> and around [[3681 BBY|seventy-five years later]], the Sith invaded the Republic.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> It wasn't until after the [[Treaty of Coruscant|conclusion]] of the resulting [[Great Galactic War]] that inquiries were made into the events surrounding the duel. It was then that [[Jedi historian]] [[Gnost-Dural]] discovered the Ovair family heritage and their role in the preparation for the invasion by the Sith Empire.<ref name="Timeline 7" /> [[Satele Shan]], the Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the era, concurred with Gnost-Dural's research and included notes on the duel on Coruscant in a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|wartime journal]] submitted to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The duel on Coruscant was first seen in the seventh entry of the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', a series of online video entries created to provide background story to the [[LucasArts]]/[[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The entry, titled [[Timeline 7: Peace for the Republic?|''Peace for the Republic?'']], is available on ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} [http://www.swtor.com official website]. It is narrated by Jedi Master Gnost-Dural, whose voice is provided by actor [[Lance Henriksen]].<ref name="news">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100416_001|text=Peace for the Republic?|nolive=1}}</ref>

''Peace for the Republic'' presents a [[Canon|continuity]] disparity regarding the destruction of Naga Sadow's spirit. While ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' claims that the Dark Lord [[Freedon Nadd]] destroyed Sadow's spirit in [[4400 BBY]], the ''Timeline'' states that the destruction instead took place during this duel.
